info.name: AppDynamics Alert and Respond Actions Nodes API

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the business application.

params.name: output
params.description: The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

items.docs: Returns all nodes associated with the specified application including node names, IDs, machine details, IP addresses, and agent version information.

info.name: List nodes for a specific tier

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the business application.

params.name: tierId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the tier.

params.name: output
params.description: The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

items.docs: Returns all nodes belonging to a specific tier within an application.
